value.author: Aysha48
value.title: Excellent
value.text:
Nice hotel
Breakfast was good
Location was good, only a couple of stops away from Sultanahmet and metro was only 5 minutes walk
Modern area
Room size was decent, good facilities
Lovely cafe to get drinks or cakes
I was also sent a birthday cake on my birthday which was a nice surprise after a day out
Most of the staff were friendly
— On the first night there was some building works either going on inside the hotel or underneath the hotel really late( after 10pm). I rang reception to ask them and got a member of staff who was a bit rude...apparently hed already told me 50 times that he would look into it. I informed him he must have had me confused with someone else( someone else probably complained before I did) but he was still very rude and i was only ringing because it was directly underneath our room and it was disturbing my baby's sleep 
Ramps were a bit steep to walk on with pushchair

value.author: Maria
value.title: Sono stata bene
value.text:
Una struttura bella centrale con ottima qualità prezzo 
Camere confortevoli e letti comodi

value.author: Margherita
value.title: Posizione comoda per visitare la parte antica della città
value.text:
Posizione perfetta: vicina alle principali attrazioni monumentali e gran bazar. Fermata del tram T1 a pochi metri, comodissimo per visitare la città.
— Colazione abbondante nella scelta ma poco curata. Forte odore di fritto poco sopportabile a prima mattina.

value.author: Clarissa
value.title: Very Good
value.text: Struttura centrale, con tutti i mezzi facilmente raggiungibili a piedi a poche centinaia di metri. Colazione ricca e varia, sia dolce che salata. Personale sempre a disposizione. Una menzione particolare al manager Hizar, che ha subito provveduto a cambiare la nostra stanza perché quella che ci era stata assegnata era troppo rumorosa.

El desayuno era buena cantidad y variedad. El personal muy querido.
— Las almohadas horribles, el olor del hotel y las habitaciones no eran agradables.
